scope: Synthetic users with separate cache scopes. Staff each authorized for one of 20 stores (4000 orders/store); admins authorized for all 80000 orders. Actual current order handler and SQL, simulated identity/authentication SELECT 1, Waitress32 / DB pool6 / isolated MySQL128MiB. Each user waits 5s AFTER response, synchronized cold starts. Request pattern per10: 7 list,1 summary,1 next-page,1 keyword search; short stages may not reach search. No real background jobs or external APIs. Closed-loop model underdelivers target traffic when slow.
